Turn your dog into a low-poly 3D model

Take nine photos from set spots around your dog. The app cuts the dog out of every shot, lets you check the cut-out, and builds a game-ready 3D mesh.

  1. 1
    Stand at nine spots
    Line your dog up with the on-screen outline. Beeps and a chime tell you when it's right.
  2. 2
    Check the cut-out
    AI finds the dog's outline. You can adjust it or include the bed.
  3. 3
    Download
    Low-poly mesh with colors (GLB, OBJ, STL, PLY).

Everything runs on your device. Your photos are never uploaded.

Before you start
CaptureCut outModel

Pick a clear spot

  • Plain background works best: an empty floor and a wall, or grass. Clutter and other people confuse the cut-out.
  • Soft, even light. Shade outdoors or a bright room. Avoid harsh shadows and backlight.
  • You need room to stand about 1 m (3 ft) from your dog on all sides. Dog on a bed? Fine: you can choose to include the bed later.
🐕 🦴

Settle your dog first

  • Ask for a sit or down + stay and reward with a treat or lick mat, or scan when they're sleepy after a walk.
  • A helper at the dog's head can hold their attention, but stay out of the shot. No hands, legs or leash across the dog.
  • Fidgety dog? Each photo takes under a second and you can shoot the spots in any order, so wait for a calm moment. The app also skips shots where the dog moved, and you can retake just those.

Nine spots, any order

  • The camera shows an outline for each spot: front, sides, back, and one from above. Fill it with your dog.
  • A level bar shows how to tilt the phone. Beeps get faster as you line up, a chime means right, and the photo is taken for you after a short hold.
  • The small map shows where to stand next. Tap any spot to jump to it.

Frame it right

  • Line the dog up inside the outline. All four paws and the tail should stay in view.
  • If the dog is cut off by the screen edge, that shot is skipped.
  • The dog's outline is found automatically. It's easiest when the dog's color contrasts with the background.

Check the cut-out
CaptureCut outModel

Bright area with a green outline = what gets turned into 3D. Dimmed = ignored. Is the bed in or out the way you want?

Sensitivity (more = keeps more, e.g. fluffy edges, bed)50
Colour range (for tapped items)40

Take 9 quick photos

Stand at each spot around your dog, in any order. Line the dog up with the outline and hold the phone like the arrow shows. A chime tells you when you’re right, and it takes the photo for you.

Turn sound on. It beeps faster as you get closer.
